title: Floating walnut desk with hidden drawers
summary: A wall-to-wall walnut desk under a window, fixed to the walls with no legs, with four drawers built into its front.
intro: A small room with a window that wanted a desk without legs. The desk spans wall to wall under the window, fixed to a batten along the back wall and into the walls at each end, so it floats. Four drawers sit within its thickness and pull out from underneath, with no handles on show. The drawer boxes were made the day before, and the desk went together and was fitted in a day.

cover.alt: Floating walnut desk spanning wall to wall under an open window

steps.title: Drawer boxes first
steps.text: The four walnut drawer boxes were built the day before outside the workshop, with tape on the edges to keep them clean until fitting.

image.alt: Walnut drawer boxes laid out on trestles outside the van

steps.title: Level line first
steps.text: On site, a level line across the room and a batten fixed along it to carry the back of the desk. Everything after this hangs off that line.

image.alt: Level line and fixing holes along the wall under the window

steps.title: Top on, runners under
steps.text: The top went on first, with walnut dividers underneath carrying the drawer runners. Once the drawers are in, none of it shows.

image.alt: The walnut desk top fitted, with drawer runners fixed underneath

steps.title: Checked and fixed
steps.text: Level checked along the length before the last fixings went in, then the drawers were fitted.

image.alt: Yellow spirit level on the fitted desk top
